To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) we propose a novel black-box adversarial attack method called NATTACK; 2) the adversarial population of a benign input to a DCCNN can be modeled with a Gaussian distribution; 3) NATTACK achieves state-of-the-art attack success rate and is applicable to different defenses; 4) we show that the adversarial examples found by NATTACK are robust and transferable to other DNNs and defenses.
